description: Find and tag invoices, orders and other documents, manage trading partners and connection requests, and assign documents to colleagues in Tradeshift.

tradeshift_assignment_closed_trigger.description: Runs when an assignment is closed.

output.assignment: The record returned by the service

tradeshift_document_status_changed_trigg.description: Runs when a document's status changes, such as an invoice being delivered, accepted, rejected or paid.

output.document: The record returned by the service

parameters.description: Only this kind of document: invoice, creditnote, order or quote. Leave empty for every kind.
parameters.name: type

tradeshift_document_updated_trigger.description: Runs when a document is changed, including its status, tags or properties.

output.document: The record returned by the service

parameters.description: Only this kind of document: invoice, creditnote, order or quote. Leave empty for every kind.
parameters.name: type

tradeshift_new_assignment_trigger.description: Runs when an assignment is created for someone in your company.

output.assignment: The record returned by the service

tradeshift_new_connection_request_trigge.description: Runs when another company asks to join your network.

output.request: The record returned by the service

tradeshift_new_connection_trigger.description: Runs when a trading partner is added to your network.

output.connection: The record returned by the service

tradeshift_new_received_document_trigger.description: Runs when a document, such as an invoice from a supplier, arrives in your inbox.

output.document: The record returned by the service

parameters.description: Only this kind of document: invoice, creditnote, order or quote. Leave empty for every kind.
parameters.name: type

tradeshift_new_sent_document_trigger.description: Runs when your company sends a document, such as an invoice or order.

output.document: The record returned by the service

parameters.description: Only this kind of document: invoice, creditnote, order or quote. Leave empty for every kind.
parameters.name: type
